topic: Cursor Composer 2.5 (C25) vs MiMo-V2.5-Pro (MM25p) — Shared Benchmarks, Exact Scores, Cost-per-Task
research_question: Find ALL benchmarks where BOTH Cursor Composer 2.5 (C25) and MiMo-V2.5-Pro (MM25p) have published scores on the SAME benchmark. For each such benchmark, provide the exact scores and attempt to calculate or estimate cost-per-task.

constraints.c25_treated_as: model (Kimi K2.5 base), not IDE agent
constraints.scope: ONLY benchmarks with BOTH models tested

key_findings.same_harness_c25_wins: 3/3 (Vals SWE-bench, Vals Terminal-Bench 2.1, Vals Vibe Code v1.1)
key_findings.terminal_bench_2_0_essentially_tied: C25 69.3% vs MM25p 68.4% (0.9 pt, possibly within noise)
key_findings.cost_reality: MM25p ~30% cheaper on Terminal-Bench 2.0 estimates; only 1 published C25 cost ($0.55 CursorBench 3.1)
key_findings.mm25p_unique_advantages: 1M context (5x), MIT license, open weights, LMArena presence, WildClawBench/PinchBench presence
